channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: BNP secures clear majority in Bangladesh polls; Tarique Rahman set to become next PM
item.description: Citing party sources, Bangladeshi Bengali Daily, Jugantor reported that party chairman Tarique Rahman is set to lead the government, marking the return of a male Prime Minister in Bangladesh after almost 35 years.

item.title: After 55-day break, TVK chief Vijay to return to public stage at Salem today amid tight security
item.description: Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) leader Vijay is all set to make a high-profile return to public life, ending a 55-day hiatus since the party’s Erode meeting, to address a gathering of party executives near Salem.

item.title: BJP questions Rahul Gandhi’s silence over Karnataka excise scam
item.description: The Karnataka BJP has questioned the silence of the Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha, Rahul Gandhi, on the alleged Rs 2,500 crore excise scam in the state.

item.title: Congress takes early lead in Telangana municipal elections
item.description: Over 73 per cent voters had cast their votes in the municipal elections in 116 municipalities and seven corporations on Wednesday. Counting of votes was taken up from 8 a.m. on Friday amid tight security.

item.title: 4.5 Stars for ‘O’Romeo’: Shahid Kapoor, Triptii Dimri Ignite the Screen in a Visual Masterpiece
item.description: Inspired by true events, Sajid Nadiadwala's O'Romeo encompasses layered elements of emotions, story and characters that are thoughtfully crafted.

item.title: Bengal SIR: ECI to set watertight guidelines for scrutiny of voters’ documents at meet today
item.description: The extended deadline for completing hearings on claims and objections to the draft voters’ list in the state will end on Saturday. The phase of the scrutiny of voters’ identity documents submitted at the hearing session will continue till February 21.

item.title: Passengers deserve real answers, not just claims: Shashi Tharoor
item.description: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor has raised serious concerns over the Civil Aviation Ministry's handling of passenger complaints, questioning the Union government's claim that 97 per cent of grievances have been addressed.

item.title: FDA clerk caught at Mantralaya by ACB accepting bribe of Rs 35,000
item.description: The Maharashtra Pradesh Congress Committee President Harshwardhan Sapkal claimed that the clerk Rajendra Dherange was arrested in a Cabinet minister's office, and the incident highlighted what he called “rampant corruption” under the BJP-led government.

item.title: Democratic, inclusive Bangladesh will always be supported: Kharge congratulates Tarique Rahman
item.description: Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge on Friday congratulated the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) and its chairperson, Tarique Rahman on their landmark win in the Bangladesh parliamentary elections.

item.title: Congress neglected Majuli, BJP govt building modern infrastructure: CM Sarma
item.description: He alleged that successive Congress governments paid little attention to the island's development, despite its immense cultural, spiritual and tourism significance.
